name: Of The Lilies
source:
As the chieftain-to-be in the small village of Tayabac, your family was counting on you to lead the tribe and take care of your people. But when your hometown is invaded by the Seiyslan Empire, you’re left without a home, without a culture, and without a family.

You were saved by Lady Sabina, who brought you into her home, with the condition that you join an organization that keeps the Seiyslan people safe. You'll have the chance to meet 5 love interests along the way: Seiji—your protective best friend, Myo—the charming rebel leader, Taji—your mysterious rival, Laisa—a cunning pirate, and Lien—the conqueror who separated you from your family.

10 years later, when the curses that come only once a century resurface, you are tasked to protect the Seiyslan Empire, the very people that took everything away from you, and are faced with a choice that forces you to decide on the path you’re willing to take to come to terms with your past. Who are you willing to sacrifice?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348900/Of_The_Lilies/]Steam[/url]]
